prompt.rangeFrom: The span to summarize: from the user message "{start}" to the user message "{end}".
prompt.rangeBackground: Everything before that span is background only, there to explain what this stretch was doing.
prompt.intro: Write one summary for later continuation, in the structure below:
prompt.heading: ## Summary of this stretch
prompt.goal: - Goal: what this stretch of work is doing
prompt.artifacts: - Artifacts: file paths, commands, config keys, quoted verbatim
prompt.attempts: - Attempts and conclusions: each attempt → feedback → why it was rejected → the final choice
requirements: Use the same language as the conversation.
Keep file paths, commands, error strings, identifiers, numbers and function signatures verbatim.
Record conclusions and reasons, not the process.
Write the record directly; do not mention these requirements.

ui.errEmptyHistory: This history is empty as far as the model is concerned, so there is nothing to summarize.
